notes: Paid people and download events are distinct units, with no public linkage, so 48/11200 must not be reported as a purchase conversion rate.
Some download events may belong to repeat visitors; payment count describes people rather than transactions; pricing and refunds are not established in the post.
The six-year cumulative observation cannot reveal year-by-year or monthly earnings, annualized profitability, or a first-launch 30/90-day cohort.
Developer reported every month cost more than it earned but supplied no monthly cash ledger and no labor valuation; no net or hourly profit is calculated.
Abandonment and asset obsolescence are specific to one project and cannot establish a platform-wide game cancellation rate.
